verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is OneDrive's admin 'manage-sharing' documentation page. It confirms that external sharing in SharePoint and OneDrive is a governed admin topic, but the quoted text only says users can share outside the organization and does not spell out the actual controls. missing for 10: explicit org-level toggles limiting who can share externally, domain allowlist/blocklist settings, link-type or expiration restrictions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, external collaboration is governed — org-level controls over who can share outside the team, with domain allowlists or link restrictions

citations.quote: External sharing in SharePoint and OneDrive allows users to share content with people outside your organization, such as partners, vendors, clients, or customers.
